description: EU research and innovation funding received by a French company, from CORDIS (European Commission, CC BY 4.0): every Horizon 2020 (2014-2020) and Horizon Europe (2021-2027) project the company appears in, with role (coordinateur, participant, partenaire_associe, tiers…), EU contribution, total cost, dates, project status (signe / clos / termine) and the official CORDIS link, plus totals (projects, EU contribution in EUR, projects under way). The company is matched by the VAT number CORDIS publishes (about 90% of French participations carry a readable one): `aucun_financement: true` is a NON-conclusive absence, never “never funded”. Facts only, no score. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_french_company_eu_funding

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: EU research funding received (CORDIS)
